question: For a bank database with customer transactions, calculate each customer's daily running balance (where deposits add to the balance and other transaction types subtract). For each customer and each day, compute the 30-day rolling average balance (only after having 30 days of data, and treating negative averages as zero). Then group these daily averages by month and find each customer's maximum 30-day average balance within each month. Sum these maximum values across all customers for each month. Consider the first month of each customer's transaction history as the baseline period and exclude it from the final results, presenting monthly totals of these summed maximum 30-day average balances.
sql:
WITH customer_month_max AS (
    WITH daily_balances AS (
        SELECT 
            customer_id,
            txn_date,
            CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount 
                     ELSE -txn_amount END) AS DOUBLE) as daily_change
        FROM customer_transactions
        GROUP BY customer_id, txn_date
    ),
    running_balances AS (
        SELECT 
            customer_id,
            txn_date,
            daily_change,
            CAST(SUM(daily_change) OVER (
                PARTITION BY customer_id 
                ORDER BY txn_date 
                ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
            ) AS DOUBLE) as running_balance,
            MIN(txn_date) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id) as first_txn_date
        FROM daily_balances
    ),
    with_rolling_avg AS (
        SELECT 
            customer_id,
            txn_date,
            running_balance,
            first_txn_date,
            CASE WHEN CAST(txn_date AS DATE) - CAST(first_txn_date AS DATE) + 1 >= 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as has_30_days,
            CAST(AVG(running_balance) OVER (
                PARTITION BY customer_id 
                ORDER BY txn_date 
                ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
            ) AS DOUBLE) as rolling_avg_balance
        FROM running_balances
    ),
    with_zero_negative AS (
        SELECT 
            customer_id,
            txn_date,
            first_txn_date,
            has_30_days,
            CASE WHEN rolling_avg_balance < 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE rolling_avg_balance END as zero_negative_avg
        FROM with_rolling_avg
        WHERE has_30_days = 1
    ),
    with_month AS (
        SELECT 
            customer_id,
            txn_date,
            first_txn_date,
            CAST(SUBSTR(txn_date, 1, 7) AS VARCHAR(7)) as month
        FROM with_zero_negative
    ),
    customer_first_month AS (
        SELECT 
            customer_id,
            MIN(txn_date) as first_txn_date,
            CAST(SUBSTR(MIN(txn_date), 1, 7) AS VARCHAR(7)) as first_month
        FROM customer_transactions
        GROUP BY customer_id
    ),
    with_first_month AS (
        SELECT 
            customer_id,
            first_month
        FROM customer_first_month
    ),
    with_filtered_month AS (
        SELECT 
            w.customer_id,
            w.txn_date,
            w.month,
            COALESCE(zm.zero_negative_avg, 0.0) as zero_negative_avg
        FROM with_month w
        JOIN with_first_month fm ON w.customer_id = fm.customer_id
        LEFT JOIN with_zero_negative zm ON w.customer_id = zm.customer_id AND w.txn_date = zm.txn_date
        WHERE w.month != fm.first_month
    )
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        month,
        MAX(zero_negative_avg) as max_30day_avg
    FROM with_filtered_month
    GROUP BY customer_id, month
)
SELECT DISTINCT month, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) as customer_count
FROM customer_month_max
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month

            has_30_days,
            CASE WHEN rolling_avg_balance < 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE rolling_avg_balance END as zero_negative_avg
        FROM with_rolling_avg
        WHERE has_30_days = 1
    ),
    with_month AS (
        SELECT 
            customer_id,
            txn_date,
            first_txn_date,
            CAST(SUBSTR(txn_date, 1, 7) AS VARCHAR(7)) as month
        FROM with_zero_negative
    ),
    customer_first_month AS (
        SELECT 
            customer_id,
            MIN(txn_date) as first_txn_date,
            CAST(SUBSTR(MIN(txn_date), 1, 7) AS VARCHAR(7)) as first_month
        FROM customer_transactions
        GROUP BY customer_id
    ),
    with_first_month AS (
        SELECT 
            customer_id,
            first_month
        FROM customer_first_month
    ),
    with_filtered_month AS (
        SELECT 
            w.customer_id,
            w.txn_date,
            w.month,
            COALESCE(zm.zero_negative_avg, 0.0) as zero_negative_avg
        FROM with_month w
        JOIN with_first_month fm ON w.customer_id = fm.customer_id
        LEFT JOIN with_zero_negative zm ON w.customer_id = zm.customer_id AND w.txn_date = zm.txn_date
        WHERE w.month != fm.first_month
    )
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        month,
        MAX(zero_negative_avg) as max_30day_avg
    FROM with_filtered_month
    GROUP BY customer_id, month
)
SELECT DISTINCT month, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) as customer_count
FROM customer_month_max
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month
